correctness.rationale: Independent branch labels yield the stationary Markov kernel P with Pe_j=p e_{2j} for odd j, and Pe_j=q e_{j/2}+p e_{2j} for even j, p=1-2a,q=2a. Dyadic level-return paths from zero are Dyck paths, so lag 2m autocovariance is Cat_m(pq)^m/2 and odd lags zero; odd parts and sin/cos are invariant orthogonal sectors. Stationary covariance convolution gives Var(S_N)=N/2+sum(N-2m)Cat_m(pq)^m. Catalan generating function yields σ²=1/max(p,q)-1/2 with slopes ±8 at a=1/4, and singularity analysis at ±1 gives 3N/2-4 sqrt(2N/pi)+4+O(N^-1/2). For a>1/4, the bounded Poisson series g=(1/q) sum_h(p/q)^h φ(2^h y) supplies martingale CLT using stationary ergodicity, not extended to a≤1/4. Independently checked dyadic walk returns at 4 rational a parameters through lag 16 and critical variance asymptotic at N=1000 (error -0.0757).
